items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, Django Reinhardt played in the band. [INTERVIEWEE] We brought him from Europe. First time ever in America, played at Carnegie Hall.

ctx.x: He was fine. But he was -- he wasn't no bigger than me. Something else, he was something else, man. Yeah, Django Reinhardt --
Yeah, Django Reinhardt played in the band.
